mapper.select: SELECT comment.id, comment.parent_id AS parentId, comment.content AS content, comment.created_at AS createdAt, comment.user_id AS userId, comment.board_id AS boardId, users.nickname AS nickName, profile.path AS profileImagePath, comment.is_del AS isDel FROM comment comment LEFT JOIN users users ON users.user_id = comment.user_id LEFT JOIN profile_files profile ON users.user_id = profile.user_id WHERE comment.board_id = #{boardId} ORDER BY CASE WHEN comment.parent_id = 0 THEN comment.id ELSE comment.parent_id END, comment.depth, comment.created_at ASC
